normalization: Records are deduplicated, normalized derivatives. Web/PDF text omits presentation, pagination and executable content. Smart-contract source is inert reference text. public_source_urls contains direct provenance or unambiguous provenance matches; referenced_public_urls contains other links appearing in a source, including citations or navigation, and does not establish primary provenance. A missing source URL means no reliable direct locator was retained. Historical URLs were not all re-fetched for this edition. Source-reference records identify documents without reproducing their full contents. Corporate excerpts are selected passages, not full facsimiles. Hashes verify delivered derivative bytes only. Incidental links are reconstructed from the actual source record and stored inside each derivative; the catalog lists their count. Source collection filenames and container fingerprints are not provenance for this edition.
